name: HDR Multiscale
summary: Wavelet-based dynamic range compression for stretched images, ported from the HDR Multiscale Siril script.
description: AfterNight port of HDR Multiscale for Siril, written by Franklin Marek for Seti Astro Suite and adapted for Siril by Cyril Richard. On a stretched mono or RGB image it decomposes Lab lightness with an a-trous B3-spline wavelet, boosts the detail layers through a luminance mask with a per-scale decay, realigns the midtones, applies a dimming curve, and blends the result in through the luminance mask so the background keeps its values. It runs on NumPy alone. AfterNight port by Ezequiel Ruiz.
author: Franklin Marek and Cyril Richard (original) / Ezequiel Ruiz (port)
attribution: AfterNight port of HDR Multiscale for Siril, written by Franklin Marek (Seti Astro Suite) and adapted for Siril by Cyril Richard. AfterNight port by Ezequiel Ruiz.
